描述_EN: the spiritual nature of the bodhisattva is shown in the elongated ear lobes representing wisdom and the long, tied up hair suggesting a continued attachment to this world. a bodhisattva is a being who delays enlightenment in order to help others achieve salvation. his serene, inward expression conveys inner knowledge and a meditative state. the holes in the head were probably for insets of precious stones. this figure is a rare example of a bodhisattva made of cast iron, once stable enough to be displayed outdoors.
描述_ZN: 菩萨的灵性表现在代表智慧的长耳垂和捆绑的长发上，表明对这个世界的持续依恋。 菩萨是一种为了帮助他人获得救赎而延迟开悟的生命。 他宁静、内向的表情传达了内在的知识和冥想的状态。 头部的孔可能是用来镶嵌宝石的。 这个人物是一个罕见的由铸铁制成的菩萨的例子，曾经稳定到可以在户外展示。
